name: EpicCentral
summary: EpicCentral is an entertainment-focused lifestyle destination in Grand Prairie featuring major attractions like Epic Waters waterpark, Topgolf, and Andretti Indoor Karting alongside diverse dining and relaxation venues. This experiential center emphasizes activities and experiences over traditional retail, creating a comprehensive entertainment complex for families and groups.
demographics: EpicCentral attracts a diverse, family-oriented demographic spanning young professionals to families with children, drawn by the entertainment-focused tenant mix. The Grand Prairie trade area serves middle to upper-middle income households seeking experiential retail and dining options. Primary visitors include millennials and Gen X families with disposable income for entertainment activities, as evidenced by the premium entertainment venues like Topgolf, Andretti Indoor Karting, and Epic Waters indoor waterpark.
description: EpicCentral is Grand Prairie's premier entertainment and lifestyle destination, redefining the traditional shopping center concept by prioritizing experiences over conventional retail. This innovative mixed-use development features an impressive array of entertainment venues including Epic Waters indoor waterpark, Bolder Adventure Park, PlayGrand Adventures, and the newly opened Topgolf facility. The center's "Thrill, Fill, and Chill" philosophy is evident throughout, with adrenaline-pumping attractions like Andretti Indoor Karting & Games and Epic Rec complemented by diverse dining options including Chicken N Pickle, Vidorra, The Finch, and Radici. Beyond entertainment and dining, EpicCentral offers unique relaxation spaces such as Illuvia spa, Jambox entertainment venue, and outdoor amenities like GrandLawn and Paths Lake Trails, creating a comprehensive destination for families and groups. The center's dog-friendly Central Bark area and event planning capabilities make it a versatile community gathering place that has earned an impressive 4.7-star rating from over 3,400 visitors.
